entities.summary: Albert Brudzewski, also known as Albert Blar, Adalbertus,Albert of Brudzewo or Albert of Brudzew was a Polish astronomer, philosopher and diplomat. A major accomplishment of Albert's was his modernization of the teaching of astronomy by introducing the most up-to-date texts. He was an influential teacher to Nicolaus Copernicus, who initiated the Copernican Revolution.
